name: Mutual NDA
description: A mutual non-disclosure agreement created by a committee of over 40 attorneys representing technology vendors, procurement teams, boutique firms, and Big Law. Covers confidential information exchanged between two parties.

name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
description: The cover page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA. Used to specify the business-specific terms (parties, dates, governing law) that are incorporated by reference into the Mutual NDA standard terms.

name: Cloud Service Agreement (CSA)
description: A standard agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, created by a committee of over 40 attorneys. Covers subscription terms, order forms, and standard terms for cloud service delivery.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: A standard design partner agreement for early-stage product collaborations, created by a committee of over 40 attorneys. Used when a vendor and a prospective customer co-develop or provide feedback on a product before general availability.

name: Service Level Agreement (SLA)
description: A standard service level agreement designed to be used alongside the Common Paper Cloud Service Agreement (CSA). Defines uptime commitments, incident response times, and remedies for service failures.

name: Professional Services Agreement (PSA)
description: A standard professional services agreement for engagements involving consulting, implementation, or other bespoke services, created by a committee of over 40 attorneys. Covers statements of work, deliverables, and payment terms.

name: Data Processing Agreement (DPA)
description: A standard data processing agreement for use when a vendor processes personal data on behalf of a customer, created by a committee of over 40 attorneys. Addresses GDPR, CCPA, and other data protection obligations.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: A standard partnership agreement for technology vendor relationships, created by a committee of over 40 attorneys. Covers reseller, referral, and co-sell arrangements between companies.

name: Software License Agreement
description: A standard software license agreement for on-premise or downloadable software, created by a committee of over 40 attorneys. Covers license grants, restrictions, support, and order form terms.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: A standard short-term pilot or trial agreement that allows a prospective customer to evaluate a product or service before committing to a full commercial contract. Simpler and easier to negotiate than a full CSA or Software License Agreement.

name: Business Associate Agreement (BAA)
description: A standard business associate agreement required under HIPAA when a vendor handles protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity, created by a committee of over 40 attorneys.

name: AI Addendum
description: A standard addendum addressing AI-specific terms and obligations, created by a committee of over 40 attorneys. Designed to be attached to a base agreement (such as a CSA or Software License Agreement) when the product or service involves AI or machine learning capabilities.
